text: もっと　たくさん　うまったら　ぜひ　わしに　みせにきてくれ！

structure.jp: もっと　たくさん　うまったら
structure.en: when it's filled in a lot more

structure.jp: ぜひ　わしに　みせにきてくれ！
structure.en: be sure to come and show me!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'when' or 'if' that thing has happened. うまったら = 'when it has filled up'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb with its ます cut off plus に and a verb of coming or going tells what you come to do. みせにきてくれ = 'come to show (me)'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: てくれ after a verb is a blunt, friendly request to do something for the speaker. きてくれ = 'come (for me)'.
